client_checkpoint_comparison.scope: redundant writes of an unchanged client storage ledger only

plan.claim_limit: Complete original ten-fixture same-size native-sampler/decode exactness with accepted graph-sharded window encoder, plus a controlled comparison of redundant unchanged client-ledger writes within one application; repeated-workload screen, no all-eager, broad visual-quality, longer-video, endurance, cold-request, performance-headline, or record claim.

always_required: fresh free-space checks and write-budget accounting
every mutated ledger durable before its dependent action
client_checkpoint_contract.only_allowed_difference: Skip rewriting an unchanged client storage ledger during repeated checks in storage-change-only mode.
client_checkpoint_contract.required_readout: Future runtime must write a source-bound policy receipt identifying the active policy and actual checkpoint/write counts for each block.

execution_preconditions: 103 full-suite and bounded-continuity output gates all pass
fresh storage admission for 5GiB writes above 50GiB reserve
reviewed policy implementation and source-bound readout receipt

fixtures.prompt: A locked-off close-up shot of a small red wooden toy boat floating on calm clear water. The boat gently rocks once as soft ripples spread outward. Warm natural daylight, realistic wood texture, consistent lighting, no camera movement. Quiet water gently laps against the boat.
A clear blue glass marble rolls slowly across a light wooden tabletop. Fixed close-up camera, soft window light, detailed reflections, quiet rolling sound.
A small yellow bird perched on a leafy branch turns its head slightly. Static camera, soft morning light, green garden background, a single quiet chirp.
A brass pendulum swings gently in front of a dark wooden clock face. Fixed camera, warm indoor light, clear metal reflections, soft rhythmic ticking.
Raindrops slide slowly down a clear window with an out-of-focus green garden behind it. Static close-up camera, soft daylight, quiet steady rain.
A folded white paper crane rests on a blue desk while one wing moves slightly in a light breeze. Fixed close-up camera, soft side lighting, faint rustling sound.
A single candle flame flickers gently above a white candle on a stone table. Static camera, dark neutral background, soft warm light, quiet room ambience.
A thin stream of clear water pours into a transparent glass on a wooden table. Fixed close-up camera, daylight, detailed ripples and reflections, gentle pouring sound.
A red fabric ribbon hanging from a branch moves gently in a light breeze. Static camera, green leaves in the background, natural daylight, quiet wind.
A small silver toy wheel turns slowly on a dark tabletop. Fixed close-up camera, soft studio lighting, clear mechanical details, a quiet rolling sound.

native_encoder_contract.method: run_ahead collects current index/tag, never prior clip

pending: reviewed immutable runtime successor and complete source/dependency closure
new same-size reference admission and receipt mode; current nodes reject proposed fields
same-size native transient plus later graph-pool memory admission
fault-halt no-retry live client; execution identities and no-cached-node checks
phase quiescence/reset contract for monotonic clip indices; no stale queued conditioning
pre-native residency/physical-free gate and explicit OOM-to-tiled-decode refusal
enforce exact capture cap64 including setup/repeats/queued tails; 5GiB allowance conditional on fresh storage admission
reserved request names/clip-index collision check before execution
bounded disk admission and reviewed reference retention
